description: A fictional wrist grappling hook launcher game prop for a mining scout, chunky low-poly, shown alone with no person, level with the hook forward. One olive painted shell bracer, a thick curved half-tube with wide chamfers, open at its rear end and underneath, with one thick plain olive top ridge along it. Exactly two wide charcoal straps with two big rectangular dark steel-framed buckles hang below the bracer. At the front of the bracer one short fat dark steel launch tube, ending in a small pointed centre spike. From the tube's front one dark steel grapnel stands open: exactly three thick curved arms, at least 20 mm thick, about 0.16 m tip to tip, spaced 120 degrees round the tube axis (one straight up, two angled down to the left and right), splayed forward and outward with their tips bent back. One fat flat round dark steel line reel sits flush in the bracer's top with one big dark steel hub cap. One small teal lamp window in a thick charcoal bezel on the left flank of the bracer. The hidden right flank is plain olive shell. Worn on the left forearm.
proportions: About 0.45 m long, 0.16 m wide and 0.2 m tall. (length : width : height = 2.81 : 1 : 1.25)
sides: the grapple is symmetric about its centre plane (x = 0) except the three-armed grapnel (one arm straight up, two down-left and down-right: symmetric about x = 0) and the lamp: the small teal lamp window is on the LEFT flank (flush). The right flank is plain olive shell. The bracer, top ridge, reel, straps, launch tube and spike are on the centre line.
